## ⚠️ 3 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7344-handler-string-any-mirrors.md`

- names `views.zod.ts` → `packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts` — edited by this change

  > The three `views.zod.ts` `z.string()` keys that are event NAMES (`onViewChange`, the two `onChange`, PR #6899) are untouched; their describe text says so and the new pin reads it. `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` records the three new runtime-slot drift rows; `content/docs/core/app-schema.mdx` spells its `AppAction.onClick` row `never` and drops the string example, the two edits the #7340 docs pin and `check:doc-snippets` require.

### `.changeset/7735-zod-mirrors-stop-authoring-defaults.md`

- names `views.zod.ts` → `packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts` — edited by this change

  > **What changed.** All 41 `.default()` call sites under `packages/types/src/zod/` are removed — `layout.zod.ts` 22, `crud.zod.ts` 11, `form.zod.ts` 5, `views.zod.ts` 2, `app.zod.ts` 1. `@object-ui/components` reconciles the third face objectui#8229 found: `flex`'s registration `defaultProps.align` seeded `'center'`, the value its own renderer never applies, so a designer-made node laid out differently from a hand-authored one; it now seeds `'start'`.

### `.changeset/9447-detail-view-handler-key-refusal.md`

- names `detail-view-handler-slots-9447.test.tsx` → `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/detail-view-handler-slots-9447.test.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **The read path was measured, not assumed.** Unlike `'detail'`, which registers `DetailView` raw, `'detail-view'` registers `DetailViewRenderer` — a data-source gate. The gate does not strip handler keys: it hands `DetailView` either the node unchanged or a shallow spread whose only overwrites are the binding keys, so an authored value arrives at `schema.onNavigate` / `schema.onAddComment` by identity and is called. Driven end to end through the real `SchemaRenderer` in `detail-view-handler-slots-9447.test.tsx`, which also records why `scripts/check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` is green here and always was: its transitive hop stops at the wrapper.

- names `scripts/check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` → `scripts/check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` — edited by this change

  > **The read path was measured, not assumed.** Unlike `'detail'`, which registers `DetailView` raw, `'detail-view'` registers `DetailViewRenderer` — a data-source gate. The gate does not strip handler keys: it hands `DetailView` either the node unchanged or a shallow spread whose only overwrites are the binding keys, so an authored value arrives at `schema.onNavigate` / `schema.onAddComment` by identity and is called. Driven end to end through the real `SchemaRenderer` in `detail-view-handler-slots-9447.test.tsx`, which also records why `scripts/check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` is green here and always was: its transitive hop stops at the wrapper.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a claim that was born false (a changeset this change adds is excluded by construction), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

## ACCEPT — in-seat review, `domain:devx` @ objectui, R70

Reviewed against **GitHub**, ⛔ not against the report's self-description. Green deduped by check name to the newest run: **36 distinct, 33 success + 3 skipped, 0 not-green**, head `bcb5251605`.

### ⭐ Your open question — ruling **A**, and your distinction is sharper than my instruction

My dispatch said ⛔ *"do not add a `KNOWN_UNDECLARED_READS` row to make this go away"*. You read that as forbidding a row that ledgers the **blind spot**, ⛔ not one that ledgers **a defect the blind spot was hiding**. **That reading is correct and better than what I wrote**, and I verified the three things that make it correct rather than taking them:

- **The live undeclared read-SITE count did not move.** The ledger goes from `detail::DetailSchema.onTabChange` to that **plus** `detail-view::DetailViewSchema.onTabChange` — the *same handler key on the same component*, now scored under the second registration that reaches `DetailView`. What grew is how many registrations reach it, which is exactly what widening a gate's vision should produce.
- **The row is self-policing.** `staleExemptions()` returns every ledger key absent from live findings ⇒ the moment the hop regresses, the row goes stale and **reds**. ⛔ It cannot decay into a silent waiver — which was the entire worry behind my instruction.
- **B is the Clause-② fork I told you to stop at**, and **C** would forfeit a landed deliverable over a row welded to the repair. Both rows carry `objectui#7804`, which owns the disposition.

⇒ ⭐ the rule I should have written is: **ledger what the fix reveals; ⛔ never ledger the fix you did not make.**

### ⚠️ One thing that made me stop hard, and one small miss

`packages/types/src/zod/views.zod.ts` is in the diff — **the exact file I named as the Clause-② tripwire** — while the PR declares `Clause-②: no`. I read the hunk before anything else.

✅ It is **comment-only**. No key declared, nothing published moves ⇒ `no` is right. ⭐ And it is a *good* change: the old docblock asserted *"`check-handler-key-read-sites.mjs` is GREEN on this key and always was. Its transitive hop stops at the wrapper"* — a claim **this very PR falsifies**. Leaving it would have left a false statement about the gate inside a published package's source.

⚠️ The miss: your summary and open questions never mention that file. I named it as the tripwire, so touching it warranted a line even when the answer is "comments only" — ⛔ not because the change is wrong, but because silence on a named tripwire costs the reviewer a hard stop.

### ⭐ The mechanism is DERIVED, and it is none of the three the card guessed

The card explicitly declined to name one and warned against inheriting it. You measured it: ⛔ not the `hops > 4` cap, ⛔ not an unresolvable wrapper reference, ⛔ not the walk stopping in the wrapper body — but **`carriesDocument` testing the raw `schema=` attribute expression**, so the render-prop hand-off `<DetailView schema={bound as DetailViewSchema} />` read as *"not the parent's document"* and `DetailView` was never enqueued.

⭐ And the sentence worth keeping: objectui#9344 peeled these type-only wrappers off a **read receiver** only, and **a lost HOP is strictly worse than a lost read, because the component leaves the census entirely.** That is the generalisation this card was actually about.

⭐ **Outcome 1 stated plainly** — you confirmed #9702 did **not** incidentally fix it, with a fresh `--list` on current `main`: `detail` (raw) yields 3 census rows, `detail-view` (wrapper) yields **0**. ⇒ ⛔ you did not build on the card's stale tree, which was the claim I most wanted tested.

⭐ **And you bounded the class**: the other 17 `elementDataSourceBlock` wrappers already hopped ⇒ **one instance, no sibling sweep owed.** ⛔ That is the difference between a fix and an open-ended hunt.

### Deliverable ② — the pin

Ten legs rebuilding objectui#9447's shape, **all ten RED under ablation**, with the mutation proven on disk (call-site count 2→1, recursion 0→1, blob `fb8841ce` → `b97508be`) and the restore proven by hash equality **plus** an empty `git diff HEAD`. ⛔ Not by an exit code. ⇒ *"the gate claims to cover X"* is now checkable, which was the whole point of that deliverable.

- `resolveComponent`'s `CallExpression` branch returns the first capitalised identifier argument and **discards the wrapper call's own body**, so a wrapper spelled `block(Inner)` that *also* renders document-carrying JSX around `Inner` would lose the outer half. ⛔ Correctly not filed: unreachable on this tree — the one such registration renders nothing around it — so no undeclared read is exposed. ⭐ Recorded in the PR's Acceptance notes with that reasoning, which is the right carrier.
- `check:sdui-registration-pins` exits 2 (**PREREQUISITE NOT MET** — no console build) ⇒ NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI, and this diff adds/removes no registration. ⭐ The gate naming its own precondition is it being honest, ⛔ not silent.
- `pnpm -s check:changeset-no-major` surfaced **exit 254 with empty output** while the script itself exits 0 — a pnpm wrapper artefact that *reads as a red gate*. ⚠️ Worth knowing: it is another instance of **a wrapper's exit status not being the instrument's verdict**.
